notes: Dresses shelf rebuilt from the 80-product 'Dress' kind (k27) and Pinafore (k29) into 11 silhouette kinds with 34 archetypes and 34 brand-register entries. Redistributed per plan: DvF models -> Wrap dress versions; Halston 704 -> Shirt dress; Mary Quant Georgie, YSL Mondrian and Trapeze -> Shift & A-line; Collectif/Bettie Page/Pinup Girl swing dresses -> Fit-and-flare; Pinup Girl Malia wiggle and Collectif Dolores -> Sheath; Schiaparelli Lobster, Versace safety-pin and Bazza Alzouman gown -> Evening gown; Thea Porter Gipsy/Faye -> Maxi; Batsheva Smock/Lillian/Snap -> Babydoll & smock; Atsuko Kudo and BustedBrand latex trimmed to one model each under a Latex dress archetype (fetish note in types); Sleeper Atlanta -> Sundress. Sent to the Traditional dress shelves (held by other workers, so not in this file): Qipao (cheongsam), Caftan, Habesha kemis, Bale albo kemis, Karakou, Kabyle dress, Robe Naili, Semlek, Blouza wahrania, Ohorokova, Tey eraz; Carla Fernandez Xilonen and Ong Shunmugam Meena likewise belong to regional/traditional dress. Dropped as unattested single-SKU product names with no archetype or retrieved page: Amrich, Anna October, Arwa The Brand, Bibi Hanum, Bouguessa (and its three ranges), Byron Lars, Design Esta, Machandmach, NO.42, Reemami, Rou So, Premet La Garconne (1920s but no source retrieved), plus the misfiled 'r' ranges Brioni Brunico/Lipari and Greiff Premium (menswear/uniform, not dresses). Generic old entries (A-line dress, Little black dress, Shirt dress, Slip dress, Tea dress, Wrap dress) became kinds or archetypes. Left out for lack of a retrieved confirming source: Ossie Clark maxi dresses (page retrieved but no named maxi confirmed), Burberry trench dress (kept as a type only), Unique Vintage (only a review page retrieved), and brand entries for Bettie Page Clothing, BustedBrand and Sleeper (no page retrieved; kept as versions/models only). Years for DvF named versions, Lolita JSKs and reproduction swing/wiggle models are left blank where no page gave them. The wiki tool failed with a lock error throughout, so all Wikipedia sources were retrieved via web_fetch. No craft traditions apply to this shelf.
